title: Which Plan Premium Charges Are Reckoned Against a Ridgecrest Advantage Closing Settlement
content:
**Clause 1.** Where a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is billed quarterly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned against the settlement is every plan premium charge posted on the account in the contract year.

**Clause 2.** Where the enrollment is billed monthly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned against the settlement is the plan premium charges posted on the account in the last 3 months.

**Clause 3.** Where fewer than 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned against the settlement is the most recent plan premium charge standing on it.

Clause 3 governs whichever cadence the enrollment is billed on: with 0 or 1 plan premium charge standing on the account the cadence makes no difference. The cadence decides only between Clause 1 and Clause 2, and only once at least 2 charges stand there.

| Plan premium charges standing on the account | Billed quarterly | Billed monthly |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 or 1 | The most recent charge standing on the account | The most recent charge standing on the account |
| 2 or more | Every charge posted in the contract year | The charges posted in the last 3 months |

*A premium account carrying 4 plan premium charges on an enrollment billed monthly, of which the two most recent fall inside the last 3 months.* Clause 2 governs, and the plan premium reckoned against the settlement is those two charges alone.
